create_GymAtari_environment: create a GymAtari environment wrapping Gym Atari with a dm_env interface for a given game and seed
reset_GymAtari: reset the GymAtari environment to start a new episode and return the first timestep
step_GymAtari: step the GymAtari environment with an action and return the resulting dm_env timestep
create_RandomNoopsEnvironmentWrapper: create a RandomNoopsEnvironmentWrapper that applies a random number of noop actions at the start of each episode
register_atari_environments: register all 57 Atari environments in Gym with Xitari-like configuration and no episode time limit
